outcomes.text: Understand written texts, including the meanings of individual words and phrases.
Summarise material and adapt it for a specific context.
Develop, analyse and evaluate facts, ideas and opinions.
Explain how writers create effects and influence their readers.
Select suitable information for particular purposes.
Recognise and respond to linguistic devices, figurative language and imagery.
Study twentieth- and twenty-first-century literature, fiction, non-fiction and other genres and text types.
Examine writers’ language, style, effects, influence, facts, ideas, perspectives, opinions and bias.
Express thoughts, feelings and imagined experiences.
Organise and communicate facts, ideas and opinions effectively.
Use varied vocabulary suited to the context.
Use sentence structures effectively and with variety.
Adapt writing to its audience, purpose and form.
Use accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar.
Create texts in descriptive, narrative, discursive, argumentative and persuasive forms for varied purposes.
Summarise material through letters, reports, newspaper reports, magazine articles, journals and speeches.
Write discursive or argumentative letters and articles.
